bounded_policy.first_pregame_source_allowance: Separate six-GET capture remains unchanged and unspent
bounded_policy.observation_scope: initial final snapshot plus at most one pending resolution or correction snapshot; further changes require a separately reviewed storage/operating version

finality_and_completeness_rules: Retain and bind each exact future asset to its original release metadata, advertised asset identity, bytes, SHA-256 and publisher update clock.
Separate publisher update, UNKNOWN upstream observation and actual metadata/CSV retrieval clocks; no reconstructed capture time.

Require exact NBA season/event/teams/start time, one row per event/player, complete required fields, valid coherent counts and explicit FINAL/post/completed status before treating an appearance as final.

For the selected event require both team inventories, each row’s team/opponent scores consistent with the final schedule, and per-team appeared-player PTS sums equal final scores. This is a partial completeness check, not independent verification of every non-scoring count.
Explicit did_not_play is required for DNP; an absent row is MISSING, never zero or inferred DNP. Unknown/nonfinal/postponed/cancelled evidence stays unscored with actual source state preserved.
Require original admitted timely forecasts; do not manufacture forecasts for the three audited past events.
Recover outcomes and grades before writes. Unchanged semantic outcomes and existing forecast/outcome grade pairs are idempotent.
Revisions append new exact evidence, outcomes, grades and correction links; source finality is provisional statistical reporting, with no invented permanent correction deadline.
